TELI:AggregatorInterface.TELI:name: cwf
TELI:AggregatorInterface.TELI:description: Clearwater Forest OOBMSM Core RMID Performance Telemetry samples definition and transformation rules

TELI:T_AggregatorSample.TELI:description: Counts the total number of unhalted core clock cycles when the core is stalled due to a demand load miss which hit in the LLC, across all cores running RMID 0
If set, RMID_0_STALLS_LLC_HIT counter reading is valid. This telemetry aggregator can track a maximum of 256 RMIDs at once. If more RMIDs are used, this bit may be cleared for some counters.
Counts the total C1 residency across all cores running RMID 0. The underlying counter increments on 100MHz clock ticks.
If set, RMID_0_C1_RESIDENCY counter reading is valid. This telemetry aggregator can track a maximum of 256 RMIDs at once. If more RMIDs are used, this bit may be cleared for some counters.
Counts the total number of unhalted core clock cycles, across all cores running RMID 0
If set, RMID_0_UNHALTED_CORE_CYCLES counter reading is valid. This telemetry aggregator can track a maximum of 256 RMIDs at once. If more RMIDs are used, this bit may be cleared for some counters.

Counts the total number of unhalted core clock cycles when the core is stalled due to a demand load miss which missed all the local caches, across all cores running RMID 0. This counter also increments when the core is executing PAUSE, TPAUSE or UMWAIT instructions.
If set, RMID_0_STALLS_LLC_MISS counter reading is valid. This telemetry aggregator can track a maximum of 256 RMIDs at once. If more RMIDs are used, this bit may be cleared for some counters.
Counts the total C6 residency across all cores running RMID 0. The underlying counter increments on crystal clock (25MHz) ticks.
If set, RMID_0_C6_RESIDENCY counter reading is valid. This telemetry aggregator can track a maximum of 256 RMIDs at once. If more RMIDs are used, this bit may be cleared for some counters.
Counts the total number of unhalted reference clock (TSC) cycles, across all cores running RMID 0
If set, RMID_0_UNHALTED_REF_CYCLES counter reading is valid. This telemetry aggregator can track a maximum of 256 RMIDs at once. If more RMIDs are used, this bit may be cleared for some counters.
Counts the total number of uops retired across all cores running RMID 0
If set, RMID_0_UOPS_RETIRED counter reading is valid. This telemetry aggregator can track a maximum of 256 RMIDs at once. If more RMIDs are used, this bit may be cleared for some counters.
